newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUX share index hits new record high.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUX share index hits new record high.

text.p: The gains of some heavyweight shares on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) propelled the BUX index to a new record high despite a mixed outcome of Tuesday's trading for Hungarian shares, dealers said.
The BUX finished at 3,579.10 points, up 7.30, while spot share turnover dropped to 800 million forints from 1.47 billion forints on Monday.
Traders said as no corporate news has been released recently, it was clear prices were triggered by events abroad.
"Prices (of Hungarian shares) rose in London (SEAQ), while the dollar also firmed," said New York Broker's Attila Gazdik.
"There is a tight relationship between prices in London and here," he said, adding today's trading was characterised by a strong selling side.
The BUX was boosted by rising oil company MOL, OTP Bank and chemicals maker Borsodchem.
MOL closed at 1,530 forints, up 50 while OTP ended at 2,550, up 55. Borsodchem rose 20 forints to 2,955.
However, the drugs company Richter extended its losses and closed at 8,050 forints, down 10.
Dealers said several players expected Richter's employee shares to enter the market over the next few days and push down prices and this triggered sellings.
Gazdik said he expected further price rises with occasional downward corrections over the next two months.
